name: Fukuyama Castle
description: Fukuyama Castle was built 1619-1622 by Mizuno Katsunari, a cousin of Tokugawa Ieyasu, to guard the west. The 1966-reconstructed keep and the original Fushin-yagura and iron gate survive beside Fukuyama Station.
notes: Keep admission ¥500 (with turret); the castle park is free.

ja.name: 福山城
ja.description: 1619年、徳川家康のいとこ水野勝成が築いた福山城。再建天守と現存する伏見櫓・鉄御門が残ります。
highlights: 現存する伏見櫓と鉄御門
ja.notes: 天守は大人500円（伏見櫓込み）。城跡公園は無料です。
